text:
Olivia Green: Hi all, quick onboarding/security Q from day 1 — I'm traveling next week to attend a conference in Spain and will be on hotel Wi-Fi and a shared airport network. Any special steps for VPN/Okta when abroad? Also curious if I can ship a hardware MFA token to my hotel address or does it need a verified personal address? :airplane:

Ben Harper: Welcome Olivia! For travel use Okta + Redwood VPN client like normal. Avoid using shared Wi-Fi without the VPN. If the hotel forces a captive portal with device certs, do not install third-party certs on the company laptop. Instead use the browser-based captive portal on your phone and share internet via hotspot or ask IT for a temporary mobile hotspot.

Sofia Rossi: Shipping MFA to hotels is hit-or-miss. We prefer shipping to your home or an office address. If it's urgent, open a ticket and IT Concierge will evaluate and may require photo ID upon delivery. For short trips, set up Okta Verify + a registered backup method instead of relying on a physical token.

Security Bot: Reminder: "Security Basics" assigned to @Olivia Green, due 14 days from 2019999999. Travel checklist: ensure MDM enrollment and disk encryption before travel. Learn: https://learn.redwood/sec-basics

Olivia Green: Thanks — one follow-up: I sometimes mirror work notes to iCloud for offline reading. Is that allowed while traveling? I take notes with customer names and API keys occasionally.

Ben Harper: Do not sync work notes to personal cloud storage. If you need offline access, use the approved secure notes app (links in the training) and enable offline mode which caches encrypted content locally only. If you already synced sensitive info to iCloud, file a ticket and IT will help remove it and rotate creds where necessary.

Sofia Rossi: Also avoid sharing the laptop with family/partners while it contains work data. If you must lend it briefly, lock the session and suspend any VPN sessions. Never let others install software or change security settings.

Olivia Green: Good to know. Another small thing: will phishing simulations be adjusted for non-English localization? I'm worried about false positives if the sim arrives in Spanish and I mis-click.

Security Bot: PhishSim cadence: randomized quarterly tests. Localization varies; we try to maintain realistic language for target audiences but remediation is the same — a short micro-course if you interact with simulated malicious content. Managers are not notified for single fails.

Olivia Green: Great — last tech ask: how do I quickly confirm FileVault is enabled on mac before I leave? Also any VPN conditional access rules that block if encryption is off?

IT Concierge: macOS check: `sudo fdesetup status` — should return "FileVault is On". For Windows use PowerShell: `Get-BitLockerVolume | ft MountPoint, ProtectionStatus`. Yes, conditional access will block VPN issuance for devices flagged as unenrolled or without disk encryption. If you see issues while abroad DM IT Concierge and include the ticket # so we can do posture checks remotely.

Olivia Green: Thanks everyone — I'll set up Okta Verify and not ship the token to the hotel. Please add me to #sec-updates and #travel-logistics. :wave:
